title: DeepdarkFocus
description: Night vision while in the deep dark.
body:
# DeepdarkFocus

Night vision in the deep dark.

## Features
- Lightweight and configurable.
- Server-side only.
- Works on Paper/Spigot/Purpur.

## Config (snippet)
```yml
amplifier: 0
duration-seconds: 5
biomes:
  - DEEP_DARK
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
